questions.question: What hardware does the home server run on?
questions.quote: The home server is a refurbished Dell OptiPlex 7050

questions.question: Where are the Docker Compose files kept?
questions.quote: the compose files live in /srv/compose, one folder per service

questions.question: What time do the backups start each night?
questions.quote: Nightly backups run at 02:00 with restic

questions.question: How long are old backups kept?
questions.quote: Seven daily, four weekly and six monthly snapshots are kept

questions.question: Is there an off-site copy of the backups?
questions.quote: every Sunday they are copied to a Backblaze B2 bucket as the off-site copy

questions.question: Where is the password for the backups?
questions.quote: The backup password is stored in the family password manager

questions.question: How do I get a deleted file back?
questions.quote: list the snapshots with restic snapshots, then run restic restore with the snapshot ID

questions.question: How often should we check that restoring actually works?
questions.quote: Test a restore on the first Saturday of every month

questions.question: The server's disk died. How do I set everything up again?
questions.quote: import the ZFS pool with zpool import tank

questions.question: Will the server restart by itself after installing updates?
questions.quote: the server reboots itself at 04:00 on Wednesdays

questions.question: How will we find out if Nextcloud goes down?
questions.quote: Uptime Kuma checks each service every five minutes

questions.question: What IP address does the server have?
questions.quote: The server has a fixed address, 192.168.1.20

questions.question: Which ports are open to the internet?
questions.quote: WireGuard listens on port 51820/UDP, which is the only port forwarded on the router

questions.question: Websites won't load on my phone but the router seems fine. What should I check?
questions.quote: check the Pi-hole container first

questions.question: How do I set up the VPN on a new laptop?
questions.quote: To add a device, run ./add-peer.sh with a name for it in /srv/compose/wireguard

questions.question: Can visitors on the guest Wi-Fi see our devices?
questions.quote: which is isolated from the rest of the network

questions.question: How much salt goes into the bread?
questions.quote: The dough is 500 g bread flour, 350 g water, 100 g active starter and 10 g salt

questions.question: How hot should the oven be for the sourdough?
questions.quote: Bake in a Dutch oven at 250 degrees C for 20 minutes with the lid on

questions.question: Why did my loaf come out dense and gummy?
questions.quote: A dense, gummy crumb usually means the dough was underproofed

questions.question: What pressure should the road bike's tyres be?
questions.quote: pump to 80 to 90 psi for a rider of about 70 kg

questions.question: When should I buy a new chain?
questions.quote: Replace the chain when a chain checker shows 0.5% wear

questions.question: How often does the chain need oiling?
questions.quote: Clean and lube the chain every 300 km, and after every ride in the rain
